content.title: SXSW 2026: South by Southwest Conference & Festivals | Visit Austin, TX
content.text: Bringing thousands of visitors to Austin each March, SXSW is one of the world's premier events showcasing music, film and innovative media. From March 12-18, 2026, the internationally-recognized event is going all out with live panels, special events, cinema and much more. Check out our guide to plan your 2026 SXSW experience. More details to be announced in early 2026. When is SXSW 2026? SXSW In-Person and Online March 12-18, 2026 From March 12-18, experience unparalleled discovery, learning, professional development, and networking with creatives from around the world. The event features Conference sessions, Film Festival screenings, Music Festival showcases, world-class exhibitions, networking opportunities, competitions, awards ceremonies, and much more. Register and book your hotel early for the best rates. Find restaurants, attractions and more planning resources in our digital Austin Insider Guide. Badge Information Depending on what you’re interested in attending, there are four different badge options available to purchase. Innovation, Film & TV and Music badges get badge holders into events for those respective festivals, while a Platinum badge provides access to all conference and festival events. Badges are available for purchase now on the SXSW website. Buy yours today before prices increase. Nico Vega at Antone's. Credit to Jim Antich. SXSW Music Festival Experience unmatched performances during SXSW Music Festival, with showcases from renowned and up-and-coming artists from around the world. The 2026 festival will include performances by The All-American Rejects, The Band Loula, Milo Korbenski, Grrrl Gang and more. In addition to international acts, The Live Music Capital of the World® represents every year with local artists, including Bayonne, Bubba Lucky, Next of Kin and more. The full 2026 lineup will be announced closer to the event. Check out the top local artists to catch at SXSW this year. Dev Patel at Monkey Man Premiere. Credit to Aaron Rogosin. SXSW Film Festival During the 39th annual SXSW Film Festival, thousands of fans, filmmakers, press, and industry leaders have the opportunity to experience film screenings, sessions, meetups and special events. A full film festival lineup will be announced closer to the event date. A few of the headlining film projects from last year included "The Studio" a comedy television show featuring Seth Rogan, Kathryn Hahn and Catherine O'Hara, "On Swift Horses" a period drama with Daisy Edgar-Jones, Jacob Elordi and Will Poulter and "The Accountant 2" an action-packed sequel starring Ben Affleck. Be sure to catch a screening of these Austin based films at SXSW this year. Conan O'Brien and Nick Kroll at the Featured Session Conan O'Brien Must Go. Credit to Andy Wenstrand. SXSW Lineup: Conference Keynotes & Featured Speakers Each year, the greatest minds from around the globe converge at the SXSW Conference and 2026 will be no different. Featured speakers for 2026 include The All-American Rejects, former First Lady Michelle Obama, actor and director Ben Stiller, President & CEO of PBS Paula Kerger, futurist Amy Webb, AI thought-leader Ian Beacraft and journalist Jon Youshaei. Stay tuned for the announcement of more Keynote Speakers and Featured Sessions in event in early 2026. Festival Footprint While the Austin Convention Center will be undergoing redevelopment and expansion during SXSW 2026, the festival’s expanded footprint will offer even more opportunities for attendees to explore the city's vibrant neighborhoods, unique venues, and local culture. The 2026 event will feature three clubhouses spread throughout Downtown Austin to serve as a hub and home base for each of the three main festivals. The Film & TV Clubhouse will be at 800 Congress, providing close proximity to The Paramount Theater, the Music Clubhouse will be at Downright Austin and the Innovative Clubhouse will be located at Brazos Hall. To see a map of other key venues, visit the SXSW website. Hotels Near SXSW Stay at one of the city's boutique hotels just south of the Lady Bird Lake in South Austin, at a trendy property with great proximity to nightlife in East Austin or at an upscale high-rise hotel in Downtown, no matter where you land you'll be close to all the action. Be sure to book your accommodations early as hotels will fill up quickly closer to the event in March. For information about transportation options during the festival, visit Get There ATX to learn more. Keep up with the full slate of panels and events at sxsw.com and make sure to check out the number of creative, tech and wellness expos at this year's event. Frequently Asked Questions What is South By Southwest? South by Southwest, commonly referred to as SXSW, is a conference and festivals that focuses discussion on several key industries like tech, music, film, education and more. Founded in Austin in 1987, this conference has grown exponentially over the years to become the world renowned conference that it is today. Learn More Where is SXSW? SXSW events take place all over the city of Austin with the main hubs located Downtown. However, the majority of the venues and events are within walking distance making it easy to get around and move from one location to the next. Getting Around Does SXSW offer accessibility resources? SXSW is dedicated to providing a variety of resources for everyone to enjoy their SXSW experience. In addition to offering Accessibility Designated SXSW Badges, the event also features ASL interpreters for keynote and select sessions, closed captioning for conference and film events, availability of companion wristbands and sensory rooms for individuals with sensitivities. Learn More Can you go to SXSW for free? A variety of exhibitions and musical showcases are free to attend throughout the week of the conference. However, to gain access to more exclusive programming or all events you will need to purchase a badge. More Free Events Who will be at SXSW? With multiple keynote speakers, exhibitions, concerts, and conference sessions, this year’s SXSW lineup is sure to impress. Visit the SXSW website to view the full lineup of speakers and musicians. See the Line Up How much does it cost to go to SXSW? Badge pricing varies depending upon which badge level you choose. Badge prices range from $820 - $1,995 depending upon which access level you choose to music, film, interactive events, or platinum access. Purchase a Badge Is SXSW a big deal? SXSW is a world renowned conference and festival that people travel from around the world to attend. This annual convergence of tech, music and film industries consume Downtown Austin every March with educational keynotes addresses, unique brand activations, constant live music and more. What's the point of SXSW? The SXSW conference and events are meant to educate and help industry professionals achieve their goals. From keynote speakers to one-on-one mentor times, SXSW offers conference goers the opportunity to hear and learn from several different industry leaders on the topics that matter to them. Learn More Can anyone go to SXSW? Anyone is welcome to purchase a badge and attend SXSW. There are a wide variety of events and exhibitions that cover a multitude of topics ensuring there is something for everyone. SXSW Topics & Tracks
